subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers use the open fork PR as the fix path, replace it with a fresh narrow Google Chat cleanup PR, or reject this placeholder cleanup?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible on current main, but an open fork PR already references this issue with closing syntax, so automation should not queue a duplicate implementation without a maintainer path choice.

options.title: Review or replace the open cleanup PR
